headline: Good news: several pharmaceutical leaders announce collectively
summary: Henlius said its anti-PD-1 antibody Hanshizhuang (serplulimab injection) has been included in China's National Reimbursement Drug List for the first time. All five approved indications are covered, including lung and gastric cancer.
why: Reimbursement list inclusion typically expands patient access and sales volume for a drug, which is a key revenue driver for drugmakers.
